Helpy / Ways neighbors help

Help for older neighbors, from people who live nearby

Groceries for a grandmother who doesn't get out much. A regular visit to the man upstairs who lives alone. Someone patient enough to explain WhatsApp. Plenty of people on Helpy want to give some of their time, and many of them choose exactly this.

Download on theApp StoreGet it onGoogle Play

For example

  • Groceries or a pharmacy run
  • A visit and a chat, once a week
  • Help with a phone, WhatsApp or booking an appointment
  • Company on the way to a check-up

How it works

  1. Download HelpyIt's free on iPhone and Android. Sign in with Google, or with Apple on iPhone.
  2. Post or browseSay what you need, or scroll to see who nearby is offering help.
  3. Sort it out in chatAgree on where and when, meet up, then rate each other.

Good to know

  • Family can post on a parent's behalf and handle the chat themselves.
  • For the first meeting, it helps if a relative is there too.
  • Never hand over a bank card, a code or a password.

Questions

My parents don't use apps. Can I ask for them?

Yes, if they live near you. Post from your phone, say what they need, and handle the chat yourself. The request is shown to neighbors around your own location in the app.

Is this a replacement for a carer?

No. Neighbors help with small tasks and company. Personal and nursing care is work for professionals.

Does it cost anything?

No. The app is free, and help between neighbors is never paid.

Who can see where I live?

Posts show a rough area and a distance, never an address. Your exact location is only shared with the neighbor you approve.

Is it safe?

Before you reach out to a neighbor, you verify your phone number. Profiles carry ratings and reviews, and you can report or block anyone in one tap. We don't run background checks, so whether to meet is always your call.
